name: 3D Instance Segmentation with Contrastive Learning
definition: A method to segment 3D Gaussian primitives into instances by training per-Gaussian features using contrastive learning on 2D masks, allowing segmentation via feature similarity.
summary: 3D Instance Segmentation with Contrastive Learning segments 3D Gaussian primitives into distinct objects by training per-Gaussian features using contrastive learning on 2D masks derived from text queries.
